lines: Send a PDF for signature from Vyre. The signer needs no account, and you get a signed copy with a page that says who signed and when.
Sync an outside app into Records: tables linked both ways, sealed fields for numbers like an SSN, and a pace the app allows.
Switching to a tab you have been on shows it at once, and every place has the same sidebar with Hide and Expand.
Connect a service from one card in the chat: Fathom, Stripe, Resend, HubSpot, Mailgun, Dropbox Sign, Zoom and Twilio.
Automations: Allow or Deny what waits for you, wait for an event, pick files and records by name, and a menu on every row.
Wide tables keep their first column in view, a board takes its columns from your stages, and Drive and OneDrive files open in Vyre's own viewers.
